title: Privacy Policy
intro: Zonic Media LLC ("Company", "we", "our", or "us") values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, maintain, and disclose information collected from users ("User", "you") of our website and services.

This policy applies to all users globally and is designed to comply with applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other relevant privacy regulations.

blocks.text: We may collect personal and non-personal information from users in various ways, including when you:

items: Fill out forms on our website

blocks.text: Personal Information May Include:
Non-Personal Information May Include:
SMS Consent & Communication
When you provide your phone number through our website forms and opt-in, you consent to receive SMS messages from Zonic Media LLC.
Types of SMS Communications
If you have consented to receive SMS communications from Zonic Media LLC, you may receive messages related to the following:
Examples of SMS Communications:
“Hello, this is a reminder for your consultation with Zonic Media. You chose a [time] slot. If you have any questions or changes, please reply to this message or give us a call.”
Important SMS Disclosures:

items: Message and data rates may apply
Message Frequency may vary depending on the type of communication. For example, you may receive (10) messages in a week regarding your consultation or service-related updates.
Example: Message frequency may vary. You may receive up to (3) messages per week related to follow-up messages regarding your consultation or services.

blocks.text: Potential Fees For Messages:
Please note that standard message and data rates may apply, depending on your carrier’s pricing plan. These fees may vary if the message is sent domestically or internationally.
Opt-In Methods
You may opt-in to receive messages from Zonic Media LLC in the following ways:

items: By filling out a paper form
By requesting to opt-in by email
By signing up for messages when you choose your consultation or services

blocks.text: Opt-Out Methods
You can opt out of receiving SMS messages at any time. Alternatively, you can contact us directly to request removal from our messaging list.

items: You can opt out at any time by replying "STOP"
For assistance, reply "HELP" or contact us directly

If you are experiencing any issues, you can reply with the keyword HELP. Or, you can get help directly by visiting our Contact Us page. Visit our privacy policy and terms and conditions page for more information or help.

blocks.text: Additional Options:
If you do not wish to receive SMS messages, you can choose not to check the SMS consent box on our forms.
We do not share phone numbers or SMS consent data with third parties for marketing purposes.
We use the information we collect to:

items: Respond to inquiries and provide customer support
Improve our services and website experience
Send updates, marketing messages, and service communications

blocks.text: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience. These may include:

items: Tracking user behavior for performance improvements

blocks.text: You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features of the site may not function properly.
We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. Only authorized personnel have access to your data.
Zonic Media LLC does not sell, rent, or trade your personal information.
We may share limited information with:

items: Legal authorities when required by law

blocks.text: All third parties are required to keep your data secure and use it only for specified purposes.

To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.
You may opt out of communications at any time:

items: Email: Click the unsubscribe link in emails
Direct Request: Email us to request data removal

blocks.text: Our services are not intended for individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page. Continued use of our website indicates acceptance of the updated policy.
By using our website and submitting your information, you consent to the collection and use of your information as outlined in this Privacy Policy.
